scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend ci
scripts.build: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=1 CI=true npm --prefix frontend run build && mkdir -p backend/public && find backend/public -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name README.md -exec rm -rf {} + && cp -R frontend/dist/. backend/public/
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend ci
